idea-plugin.name: Flaky Test Detector
idea-plugin.description:
Flaky Test Detector — Stop Guessing Which Tests You Can Trust

Automatically track test execution history and identify flaky tests in your project. Each test gets a reliability score so you know which tests are stable and which need attention.

Features

  • Automatic Tracking — Records every test run (pass/fail/error/skip) automatically
  • Flakiness Score — Percentage-based reliability metric per test
  • Gutter Icons — Reliability indicators on Java and Kotlin test methods
  • Dashboard — Sortable, filterable table with last-10-runs sparkline and trend
  • Quarantine — Mark known-flaky tests in the dashboard, manually or automatically above a threshold
  • Configurable — Category thresholds, minimum runs and history retention

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.2+ or another JetBrains IDE with a test runner
  • Tests run from the IDE (results of the IDE's test runner are recorded)

Support

Documentation | Issue Tracker | Contact Support

idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.8.0

  • The plugin is now completely free — all features unlocked, no license needed.
  • Source code is now open source under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/JirakJ/flaky-test-detector

What's New

  • Automatic Test Tracking - Records pass, fail, error, and skip results for every test execution
  • Flakiness Score - Calculates a percentage-based reliability score from test history
  • Gutter Icons - Color-coded reliability indicators next to @Test annotations in the editor
  • Flaky Tests Dashboard - Sortable table with sparkline visualizations of test stability
  • Quarantine Mode - Mark known-flaky tests to prevent them from blocking your workflow
  • Configurable Thresholds - Set custom levels for suspicious, flaky, and highly unstable tests
